"import cadquery as cq

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Closed profile sketch on the XZ plane (all local sketch coords in mm).
# Local (u, v) maps to global (x, y, z) = (u, 0, v):
#   local u -> global +X, local v -> global +Z
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
P = cq.Plane.named("XZ")


def pt(u, v):
    """Map local sketch coordinates to world coordinates on the XZ plane."""
    return P.toWorldCoords((u, v))


# --- Entity 1: Line from (34, 0) to (6, -20) -------------------------------
A = pt(34.0, 0.0)
B = pt(6.0, -20.0)
edge1 = cq.Edge.makeLine(A, B)

# --- Entity 2: Line from (6, -20) to (-34, 0) ------------------------------
C = pt(-34.0, 0.0)
edge2 = cq.Edge.makeLine(B, C)

# --- Entity 3: Fitted spline through the fit points (smooth, no kinks) -----
spline_pts = [
    pt(-34.0, 0.0),
    pt(-11.333333, 17.0),
    pt(11.333333, 32.0),
    pt(34.0, 0.0),
]
edge3 = cq.Edge.makeSpline(spline_pts)

# --- Assemble exactly the 3 entities into one compound of edges ------------
edges = [edge1, edge2, edge3]

# Junctions are coincident by construction (shared Vector endpoints):
#   line1 end (6,-20) == line2 start, line2 end (-34,0) == spline start,
#   spline end (34,0) == line1 start  -> exactly one closed loop.

# --- Export -----------------------------------------------------------------
cq.exporters.export(cq.Compound.makeCompound(edges), "sketch.step")"
